title: Database K's Dimension
description: The not so dependent dependency for my other Datapack that includes a simple dark dimension with no escape made of pure black concrete.
body: Just a simple dimension called the Subspace. A dark and quiet place with the only hope of you escaping being the villagers that roam and like in those lands. Side compatibility with my main datapack Database_K. It has only one biome of pure black concrete mimicking the overworld. You will find caverns and caves, crevases and cracks, but no home. Find villages and learn the way of life in the... Subspace
